programs.title: Redemption Day
programs.desc: (2021) Action thriller with Gary Dourdan, Serinda Swan and Andy Garcia. A war hero embarks on a daring rescue mission when his wife is kidnapped. As the clock counts down, can he get to her in time?

programs.title: Big Kill
programs.desc: (2019) Modern western with Jason Patric and Danny Trejo. Two misfit gamblers on the run, a tenderfoot and a deadly preacher team up for a date with destiny in a boom town gone bust.

programs.title: House of Darkness
programs.desc: (2002) Supernatural horror with Kate Bosworth and Justin Long. A man accompanies a mysterious woman to her secluded estate, but shadowy figures make it clear he isn't welcome.

programs.title: Wrangler
programs.desc: (1989) Western with Jeff Fahey. In Australia's untamed outback, a woman will stop at nothing to save her family's ranch, while two rival suitors will risk everything to win her heart...
